back_translation: The word of the LORD that came to Jeremiah the prophet concerning the Philistines, before Pharaoh struck Gaza.

This is what the LORD says: Behold, waters are rising from the north and will become an overflowing torrent; they will overflow the land and its fullness, the city and those who dwell in it. The people will cry out, and all who dwell in the land will wail
at the sound of the galloping hooves of his stallions, at the rumbling of his chariots and the clatter of their wheels. The fathers do not turn back for their children, because their hands are limp,

because of the day that is coming to destroy all the Philistines, to cut off from Tyre and Sidon every surviving helper. For the LORD is about to destroy the Philistines, the remnant of the island of Caphtor.
Baldness has come upon Gaza; Ashkelon is silenced. O remnant of their valley, how long will you gash yourself?
Alas, O sword of the LORD, how long until you are quiet? Return into your sheath; rest and be still.
How can it be quiet, when the LORD has commanded it? Against Ashkelon and against the shore of the sea—there he has appointed it.
